name: borsdata-mcp-dotnet
description: Börsdata financial data and multi-KPI instrument screening via a bundled .NET app. Requires your own Börsdata account with API access.
long_description:
Bundles a framework-dependent dotnet publish of the borsdata-mcp-dotnet server directly in this .mcpb. Requires the .NET 10 runtime to be installed on this machine (not the SDK). No separate build step for the end user — the app is built into the bundle at packaging time (see .github/workflows/build.yml).

This extension does not include a Börsdata subscription or API key of its own. You need your own Börsdata account with API access (https://borsdata.se) and must enter your own API key below — the server will not work without one.

Disclaimer: this is an unofficial, community-built project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Börsdata AB. "Börsdata" is a trademark of Börsdata AB, used here only to describe compatibility with their public API. You are responsible for your own Börsdata subscription, API key, and compliance with Börsdata's own terms of service. This software is provided as-is, without warranty of any kind.

api_key.title: Börsdata API Key
api_key.description: Your own Börsdata API key. Requires an active Börsdata account with API access (https://borsdata.se/en/insights/api) — not included with this extension.
